dct_description_sm: The file contains the following variables and the units of measurement: date is the sampling date (year-month-day), latitude and longitude (decimal degrees), DOC dissolved organic carbon (mg/L), TP - total phosphorus (ug/L), TN - total nitrogen (mg/L), phosphate (ug/L), DN - dissolved nitrogen (mg/L), Temperature (°C), SPM - suspended particulate matter concentration (mg/L), aCDOM(440) - absorption coefficient at 440 nm (m-1), chlorophyll-a (ug/L), summer river discharge (km3), coastal salinity (PSU).

Data were collected from rivers and coastal sites in eastern James Bay as part of the Coastal Habitat Comprehensive Research Project (CHCRP), territory of Eeyou Istchee, Quebec, Canada. The datasets include measurements from summer 2018 and 2019. Each dataset provides site codes, coordinates of the sampling locations, date of sampling, and a series of physico-chemical water properties collected from the subsurface, including nutrient concentrations, suspended particulate matter (SPM) concentration, salinity, and more.
dct_title_s: Water Properties of Rivers and Coastal Sites in Eastern James Bay (Summer 2018 & Summer 2019)
